facts.business: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited is one of India's leading spirits companies with a diversified portfolio spanning mass premium, prestige, semi-premium, premium and emerging luxury segments, anchored by iconic brands such as Officer's Choice Whisky, Officer's Choice Blue, Sterling Reserve and ICONiQ White.
